name: offer.eval
description: Evaluate an offer or late-stage role against Mike's stated goals: $250K+ all-in (reach $325K), and the priority order fitness, James, learning. Input: comp components, role, location, expectations.

all_in_band.instructions: All-in first-year compensation from base, target bonus and expected annual equity value

equity_real.instructions: The equity component has a plausible, explained value (public stock, recent priced round, or stated FMV) rather than an unquantified promise

protects_priorities.instructions: The role's travel, hours and location expectations leave room for daily training and family time

learning_curve.instructions: The role would materially grow the candidate's enterprise AI leadership scope

negotiable.instructions: The offer language leaves room to negotiate base, bonus or equity

rules.reason: in floor band, below reach -- negotiate

notes: Created 2026-09-18 for Project Get a Job. Advisory until labelled.
